name: Ruth
title: The Faithful Moabite
summary: Ruth was a Moabite woman who became part of Israel's history through her extraordinary loyalty to her mother-in-law Naomi. She left her homeland and her god to follow Naomi and the God of Israel. She married Boaz and became the great-grandmother of King David—and thus part of the lineage of the Messiah.

keyEvents.title: The Choice to Follow Naomi
keyEvents.description: Ruth refused to leave her mother-in-law and declared: 'Your people shall be my people, and your God my God.'

keyEvents.title: Gleaning in Boaz's Field
keyEvents.description: Ruth gleaned grain behind the harvesters and found favor with Boaz, the landowner and a relative of Naomi.

keyEvents.title: At the Threshing Floor
keyEvents.description: On Naomi's advice, Ruth went to Boaz at the threshing floor and asked him to act as her kinsman-redeemer.

keyEvents.title: Boaz the Redeemer
keyEvents.description: Boaz redeemed Ruth at the city gate and took her as his wife according to the law of kinship.

keyEvents.title: In the Lineage of the Messiah
keyEvents.description: Ruth gave birth to Obed, who became the father of Jesse, who became the father of David - and thus she entered Jesus' family tree.
